title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> Adobe Audition CS6 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with good sound captures a great song selection, featuring a 16‑minute Playing In The Band and a strong 15‑song second set.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the show’s extensive setlist, highlighting the lengthy PITB and the energetic fifteen‑song second set. They also note that the release is a true soundboard source with good overall sound quality and tight harmonies. No technical flaws are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it is enthusiastic about both the performance and the soundboard recording; limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as good with clear harmonies; no specific issues or mix problems reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show starts with the last song of the first set, a 16‑minute PITB, then moves into an extensive 15‑song second set, providing solid momentum throughout.
